title.narrative: UNICEF Afghanistan’s Communication section led impactful advocacy and media engagement, maintaining a 39% ‘share of voice’ in national media and engaging globally, in particular on girls’ education, nutrition, climate change and emergencies. With 90% multi-media packages, 5% social media engagement rates and 2.57 M followers, it amplified donor visibility, polio campaigns and storytelling.
